title: Concrete Driveway Installation
shortDescription: Custom-poured concrete driveways engineered for Ontario weather — proper base prep, reinforced steel, and the right control joints to prevent cracking.
fullDescription: A driveway is one of the largest concrete surfaces on your property — and the one that takes the heaviest beating from Ontario winters. We pour 4" reinforced concrete (6" for heavy vehicles) on a properly compacted granular base with drainage built in from day one. Every install includes engineered control joints, air-entrained concrete to resist freeze-thaw scaling, and a written workmanship warranty. We grade for water runoff, finish to your preferred texture, and walk the project with you before pouring so there are no surprises.

title: Stamped Concrete Driveways
shortDescription: The look of natural stone, brick, or slate with the strength of a poured concrete driveway — custom patterns and colours to match your home.
fullDescription: Stamped concrete gives you the high-end look of cobblestone, slate, brick, or flagstone at a fraction of the cost — and with none of the weed-filled joints. We integrally colour the mix, stamp the freshly poured surface with industry-grade textured mats, and seal the finished driveway with a UV-stable acrylic. The result is a one-piece, low-maintenance driveway with the curb appeal of a custom hardscape. Choose from dozens of pattern + colour combinations during your free design consultation.
features: Stone, slate, brick, and flagstone patterns

title: Exposed Aggregate Driveways
shortDescription: A naturally textured, slip-resistant driveway finish that highlights the pebbles and stones inside the concrete — perfect for sloped sites.
fullDescription: Exposed aggregate driveways are poured the same way as standard concrete, but the top layer of cement is washed away while the slab is still curing — revealing the decorative aggregate underneath. The result is a beautiful, naturally textured driveway that grips like sandpaper underfoot (ideal for steep approaches) and hides minor staining better than a smooth finish. We hand-select the stone blend during your consultation and seal the finished surface for years of low-maintenance performance.
features: Choice of pebble colour and size

title: Concrete Driveway Repair & Resurfacing
shortDescription: Crack stitching, slab lifting, and full resurfacing options that add 10–15 years to a tired driveway — without the cost of a full tear-out.
fullDescription: Not every driveway needs to be torn out and re-poured. If the underlying slab is structurally sound, we can repair cracks with epoxy injection, lift sunken sections with polyurethane foam, and resurface the entire driveway with a 1"–2" bonded concrete overlay. The result looks brand new, costs a fraction of replacement, and adds 10–15 years to the life of your driveway. We start with an honest assessment — if the slab is too far gone, we'll tell you and quote a full replacement instead.

title: Concrete Patios
shortDescription: Custom backyard patios poured to match your home — broom, smooth, stamped, or exposed aggregate finishes built for entertaining.
fullDescription: Your backyard patio is the foundation of every barbecue, family gathering, and quiet morning coffee. We pour custom concrete patios with the same engineered base and reinforcement as our driveways — but with the design flexibility to match your home's style. Choose from broom-finished modern patios, stamped patterns that mimic flagstone, or polished and coloured surfaces for a high-end finish. We can integrate seating walls, fire pits, and built-in planters during the pour so everything is tied together as one cohesive design.
features: Optional seating walls and fire pits

title: Concrete Walkways & Sidewalks
shortDescription: Front walkways, side paths, and city-spec sidewalks poured to last — with proper grading and control joints to prevent uplift.
fullDescription: A custom-poured concrete walkway frames your front entry and welcomes guests properly. We pour walkways with the same care as our driveways — proper base prep, mesh reinforcement, control joints in the right places, and a slope that drains water away from the house. We also handle city-spec sidewalk replacements (required when re-grading or driveway widening triggers a city inspection) and can integrate stamped or exposed aggregate accents to tie the walkway into a stamped driveway design.

title: Concrete Pool Decks
shortDescription: Slip-resistant, cool-to-the-touch pool deck surfaces — broom, exposed aggregate, or stamped finishes with anti-slip additives.
fullDescription: Pool decks face a brutal combination of chlorine, sunscreen, sun, and bare feet. We pour pool decks with anti-slip additives baked into the mix, gentle grading away from the pool coping, and finishes designed to stay cool underfoot during August heat waves. Choose from broom-finished standard concrete, exposed aggregate for grip, or stamped patterns that mimic flagstone or natural stone. Every pool deck is sealed with a non-yellowing, chlorine-resistant sealer that keeps the surface looking sharp for years.

title: Garage Floor Pouring
shortDescription: Reinforced concrete garage floors poured for heavy vehicles, oil resistance, and easy cleanup — with optional sealed or epoxy finishes.
fullDescription: A garage floor takes more abuse than almost any other concrete surface in your home — vehicle weight, dropped tools, oil drips, road salt off the tires, and constant temperature swings. We pour garage floors with 4"–6" reinforced concrete on a properly compacted base, with a slight slope toward the door for drainage. Finish options include sealed broom (low cost), polished concrete (modern, easy to clean), or full epoxy systems (showroom finish, chemical resistant). We can also pour new floors during home additions or detached garage builds.
